reviews.title: Unauthorized Charges and Impossible to Cancel
reviews.text:
My mother subscribed to this app, and what followed has been an extremely frustrating experience. We have been trying to cancel the subscription and stop recurring charges, but the process has been unnecessarily difficult.

Despite our attempts to cancel, including removing the payment authorization through PayPal, another $60 charge appeared on her Apple Card. We have contacted customer support multiple times by email and have received no response.

It is unacceptable for a company to make cancellation so difficult while continuing to charge customers and ignoring their requests for assistance.

We are requesting an immediate cancellation of all active subscriptions, written confirmation that no further charges will occur, and a refund of the charges made after our attempts to cancel.

I strongly advise anyone considering this app to be extremely cautious about subscribing until the company improves its billing transparency, cancellation process, and customer support.

Apparently not, as I was charged $54.91 a couple days later. 

I’ve reached out to get help with cancelling this subscription, and asked for a refund as I thought I had cancelled, to be told that I need to do all these other steps to cancel. I’ve responded, saying I’m unable to cancel using the information provided, and they eventually just stopped responding. So I guess I’m stuck with filing a fraud claim with my bank. 

Just be cautious when agreeing to this subscription. Make sure you want to keep it forever.

reviews.text: It used to be my favorite app, now it’s a total disappointment. Bring back the old UI!After the latest update, using this app has become absolutely unbearable. Why ruin something that worked perfectly fine?First of all, they introduced these ridiculous, annoying sounds for literally every single tap. It feels like I downloaded a game for toddlers, not a language learning service. It is incredibly distracting and irritating.Secondly, they completely broke the UI in the Wordcraft game. I have the screen zoom enabled in my phone settings, and everything used to display perfectly before—there was plenty of room for everything. Now, the hidden word blocks don’t even fit on the screen fully, so I have to constantly scroll down! Meanwhile, there is a ton of completely wasted space at the top of the screen featuring useless illustrations of some guy or a girl alongside unnecessary text. The most crucial information is cut off, while giant, useless pictures take up half the screen.I have absolutely no desire to even open the app anymore. This update has completely killed my motivation to study. Developers, please listen to your users and fix this nightmare!

reviews.title: Frustrating
reviews.text:
I chose this app as an additional learning tool to supplement another language app. I found Ewa frustrating to use, the sound quality was poor and the speed of talking in the video clips made them difficult to understand plus the lack of variety in the practice material make lessons boring and difficult to learn (despite the relentless cheerful enthusiasm of the avatars).

Canceling the subscription was another big headache. It turns out that it is very easy to cancel your account without canceling the subscription, so bills keep coming and it is difficult to get support (either from Ewa or from paddle.com, the billing agent) to resolve the situation. I had the feeling the support staff was more concerned with supplying a quick response to an email than actually helping resolve the issue at hand.

reviews.title: It’s just OK
reviews.text:
1) I’m an adult, so I don’t need a bunch of children’s cartoons and participation prizes, which seems to be the point of 90% of this app. 
2) Each of the books I read were clearly entirely translated by a bad AI with no humans reviewing it for errors. 
2) Also, there’s no punctuation in the books, other than periods, making it hard to follow a simple conversation when you can’t tell who’s talking! 
3) Worse, when you click on the “translate” area to get help about who IS talking in a conversation, the AI translates everything to the masculine “he”, “his”, “him” etc even when it’s a woman. 

I’m done. Now looking for something better.

And that’s after I’ve already paid full price for it. At every turn it offers me a different price to buy what I’ve already bought; clicking “don’t show me this again” never works. The prompts to dismiss the popups are tricky so just moving around in the app that I’ve already paid for is a minefield of constant, irritating popups. It wasn’t like this when I first installed it, but in recent weeks this has become unbearable. Canceled. Uninstalling. Even though I already paid and have nearly a year left to use it. Sadly, if it weren’t for this nonsense, the app itself is decent. Beware this vendor.

reviews.title: Poor quality audio, poor translation, many missing or wrong pronounciations
reviews.text: The multitude of five star reviews are fake. The movie clips are dubbed and often too short to hear the words. There’s no spaced repetition in the lessons so you just go through the same few words over and over and over again. You can’t delete anything from your vocabulary list so you still have to translate words like “no”. The translations are frequently wrong and the pronunciations of Spanish words are sometimes in English. The only good thing about this app is the audiobook feature, but beware, the extensive library is almost entirely in robotic tinny machine voices that just march through each word without actually telling you a story. In the Spanish version, there are 21 books that are read by humans but these are beginner level summaries. If all you want to do is read (without audio option), there is a good collection here, but you can get that for free through a library. As others have said, they use the deceptive practice of providing the subscription outside of Apple so it does not show up on your Apple Store account.

reviews.title:
Dear Support Team,

I am requesting the immediate and permanent cancellation of my subscription.
reviews.text:
Dear Support Team,

I am requesting the immediate and permanent cancellation of my subscription. I previously contacted you regarding this matter, and I was informed that my subscription would be canceled. However, I am still being charged despite your confirmation.

I have already deleted the application and I am no longer using your service. I kindly request that you cancel my subscription immediately and stop any further charges to my account.

Please be advised that I have screenshots of our previous correspondence showing that I informed you I was no longer using the application and requested the cancellation of my subscription. Despite this request, charges have continued to be made.

If this issue is not resolved immediately and the unauthorized charges continue, I will be forced to take further action and pursue this matter through the appropriate legal channels.

I expect written confirmation that my subscription has been canceled and that no further charges will be made.

Thank you.

Do you want to cancel or get a refund.” I’ve now turned all emails, policy statement, and invoice over to my bank to dispute the charge. Just be aware before you subscribe. You may not get a refund and you’re signing up for auto-renewal.

You can’t unsubscribe from the app and won’t know that you’ve subscribed until they charge your payment method on file for your phone. Don’t sign up for any app that doesn’t let you close your account from the profile, especially if it’s telling you to unsubscribe through your phone but doesn’t have it listed. You have no way of knowing and no notice that they’re charging you because it’s a scam. No ethical company would sneak a subscription service in without the ability to cancel in the app.

reviews.title: Deceitful
reviews.text: You can’t unsubscribe in the app. It doesn’t show up in Apple subscription sections. The only indication is the email they send as SOON as they charge you - not earlier to ensure you even want the charge. They use AI, not humans, for support. You have to login on the website to cancel. They don’t even make that easy they have a pop up ad to redirect you to the app (where you can’t manage the subscription) with the tiniest “X” ever seen so you can close it to get to your account online. It’s a deceitful practice. Buyer beware - they don’t gaf, they don’t respond, they use AI and their business practice is shady in how they treat spending your money. I don’t recommended and I’m stuck with the charge and an app I don’t want through August. I’m keeping it to make sure they don’t charge me again and I alerted my card company of never accepting a charge from them again. Horrible, horrible business practice.

reviews.title: False Advertising and Poor Customer Service
reviews.text: I am at an advanced level in Spanish.  The app said it could help with growing my vocabulary and getting to a more advanced level.  I decided to try it and signed up.  Despite my profile saying advanced, all the lessons were beginner level.  I reached out thinking maybe it was a technical issue and their reply was instructions on how to cancel. I followed up again asking if they can resolve the issue instead and once again they replied with how to cancel.  I’ve canceled and have asked for a full refund since they did not provide the service promised.  I sincerely hope they refund my money because it was a total waste of my time.

reviews.title: Bait and switch, lame interface
reviews.text:
The 5-star reviews must be bots. No matter what level you test at the beginning, you can’t skip ahead and have to test out of each tedious section. The whole dubbed movie clips thing is gimmicky, not like natural language. 
The abridged audiobooks are ok, but selection is very limited and you just have to scroll through all the titles to find what is available in your level (no filter in search ).
I purchased a three month subscription thinking it was a low-commitment but after 3 months, they renewed it automatically for another three months. There is no way to cancel in the app and it isn’t listed in your Apple account subscriptions. To cancel, I had to log into the website. They tell you this in “terms” that you receive in email after signing up, but you never see this in app on phone.

reviews.title: Overall
reviews.text: The audio is so bad it is disheartening getting it wrong because of the audio.

reviews.title: Ion
reviews.text:
Don't even think about downloading this program, you will lose your money and nerves. I cancelled my subscription, but a month later they charged me again. I wrote to them the next day. We corresponded for a whole week. In the end, they didn't return the money. 

Be careful and I don't recommend it !!!!!!!!

reviews.title: Glitchy
reviews.text: Won’t let me go to the next level despite me passing the test, support doesn’t reply, I only got one reply and they hadn’t read my email properly and were not helpful

reviews.title: Avoid at all costs
reviews.text: I signed up for a trial, then got pestered by constant messages which I could not switch off even after deleting the app.

reviews.title: Very bad in-app and customer support experience
reviews.text:
Even the content was good, I never managed to find subscription page to cancel it before it renews, so I sent them an email about it at the beginning of my user journey. After that they never helped and I forgot that I have a subscription and when it renewed I sent them an email saying it was accidental so I request a refund and an immediate cancellation of my subscription. They responded saying please check our doc term&conditions. We don’t refund for renewals. It’s really crazy that they designed the whole ux in a way that you cannot control your subscription easily. In my case I highlighted that it was me not being able to cancel my subscription (they already have my first email about me saying please cancel my subscription -they didn’t-)

Funny part was their support function only sent me a doc rather than finding a solution for my case.

Horrible user experience.

reviews.title: Careful with the 14 day money back guarantee
reviews.text:
This app functions much like other language-learning apps, without offering anything particularly unique. I’d strongly advise against signing up for the premium membership. Although they advertise a 14-day money-back guarantee, in practice it’s extremely difficult to claim a refund. There appear to be specific conditions you must meet, but these aren’t clearly explained, which makes the whole process frustrating and misleading.

I’ve also yet to receive my refund, despite requesting it, which only adds to the disappointment.

reviews.title: Super glitchy
reviews.text:
There are some good things here. But it’s super glitchy. And writing to support, even repeatedly gets no response. 

The lesson section of my app has been stuck for more than a week. I passed the test for current section, but no new lessons appear. This has happened several times. In the past, writing to support 3+ times eventually gave me more content. Not this time. 

Also, you’re able to set a learning level in the app - but this has NOT given me lessons at my current level. 

Some of the AI voicing of German text, especially in flash cards, is wrong. Close, but wrong. 

Overall, disappointing for a Paid app. I’ll be looking for something else. 

I downloaded this app because of the ads showing reading with translations available for words you don’t know (you can also add them to your list to learn). This feature is cool. Though the translations are from Google - and when moved to flash cards they’re not always right.

reviews.title: Really this is slop
reviews.text:
It’s fun to read a book in Spanish. The paragraph-by-paragraph translations are excellent. But the app developers didn’t have to do that. The feature I expected from an app like this is for each word to have a translation and for me to be able to select each word to see it rather than to compare two paragraphs in different languages to suss out what words mean what. The advertising leads you to expect that this will be the case, but in practice MANY of the words are mis-translated, if they have any translation at all. In many cases you tap on a word to learn it and all you see is the same word you tapped on, not translated.

And the quiz process for words you select to learn is lame and unhelpful. You have to unscramble the words’ letters in order, which isn’t that educational and is laborious. I’d rather be able to just type them out if you want to teach me to spell them. There’s no reason the interface couldn’t offer both methods.

And the animations shown in the ads are entirely made up. Don’t expect to see any of those.

reviews.title: Connection issues
reviews.text: I have Internet. I have mobile data. And I still can’t access the videos or the lessons that I need to get to the next level. I don’t know what it is but it makes it really frustrating when using this app. I have reset it uninstalled it. And still the videos and the lessons won’t load. It says that I have lost connection. I check twice on other apps like Duolingo and Instagram but this app is only saying I have no connection. I payed a lot of money to use this and now it’s not working. Fix it or I want a refund.

reviews.title: Questionable content not suitable for kids
reviews.text: Different learning technique for sure. Haven’t tried the books yet, but the 4th Spanish lesson on gustar is def not for kids. I thought maybe the app formula did not realize me/te gusto has sexual connotations when used with people, but taking a second look at the icon for lesson four… well maybe it does! Would not recommend for some kids—not sure what other questionable material will pop up. Also the movie clips are a bit off with the vocabulary not matching the original script. It’s like they just put random words with random clips. Hoping the book offerings will be better.

reviews.title: Spanish
reviews.text: I am working my way through steadily bur I find some of the voices difficult to understand,they are very blurred.

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text:
This app is a bit of a mess sadly. It has nice images and animations but doesn’t really deliver in teaching a language. I downloaded it because the advert I saw suggested it had great reading abilities to read a book in Spanish, but the reality looks different from the adverts-the ads were better actually 😆
They use the coin system so you can’t read unless you earn coins etc. it’s pretty much a waste of time :(

reviews.title: Scam?
reviews.text:
I downloaded this from the instagram ad and maybe that was my downfall. 

I saw there was a money back guarantee so I felt pretty safe opting for the 3 month option.

The app did not allow me to adjust my level and kept me on beginner. The pre-download quiz that I did was useless and none of the details transferred over.

I reached out to them to change it but got no response. I then asked for my money back per the guarantee and also got no response. I’ve reached out on three separate occasions using the in app contact us functionality. 

I don’t recommend this to anyone and I’m highly disappointed.

reviews.title: Accents
reviews.text:
Surely the app should be mirroring good practice and helping us to pay attention to honing our accent, instead too often there are American accented mispronunciations of words and particularly those with the letter J, why?
Also, for a paid app, there are a ridiculous number of cookies that need to be denied access in a protracted exercise that should be accepted or denied with a single click, very suspicious.

reviews.title: Scam Scam Scam Scam Scam Scam Scam Scam Sca Scam Scam Scam
reviews.text:
I downloaded this app because their promotional videos use a British RP accent, which is what I wanted to learn. In reality, the app only uses an American accent.

I unsubscribed from the App Store the same day, but three months later I noticed they were still charging me. When I contacted them, they said I must cancel through their website, otherwise they will keep charging me.

I explained that their advertising is misleading and that I haven’t used the app at all, but they refused to refund or cancel it.

I’m 50 years old and have been downloading apps for 25 years, and this is the first time I’ve written a negative review.

Completely dishonest behavior. Stay away from this app.

reviews.title: Waste of Money
reviews.text: Gamified nonsense. Impossible to find where to pick up having made progress yesterday. Less gamification and more focus on learning. 2/10 see me after class

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: I bought a subscription and set my level to intermediate, but the app started teaching me as if I knew no English at all. Then a message appeared asking if I wanted “better learning tools” with no price shown. After I clicked yes, it turned out to be another paid subscription. I contacted customer service immediately to cancel. First they said they didn’t understand the issue. After I asked again, they replied that everything looked fine on their side. Scam.

reviews.title: Poor App
reviews.text: I completed first stage of this but then had to complete a test before moving on to the next stage. It is so hard to make out the sound on bits of videos and I am constantly getting 6/9 which doesn’t let me progress to next stage. How do I skip this. Using overdubs on tv shows like Friends is not ideal with laughter and music making it so difficult to hear.

reviews.title: Subscription Trap & Scam Business
reviews.text: If you want to cancel your subscription or request a refund, Ewa will not honor your request even if you are well within your window to cancel and request a refund. You will need to file a charge dispute with your bank and place a stop payment order (revoke Ewa’s permission to charge your card). This is not standard business practice in the US. Check the reviews in the App store and Reddit. Some people have stated that they needed to deactivate their card used when they subscribed to a trial period of the Ewa app. Ewa won’t cancel your subscription even if you ask and they don’t respond to emails in a timely manner. When I requested my refund and demanded a cancellation of my subscription, an EWA service rep asked me “what don’t you like about the app” instead of processing my refund. Ewa uses a third party AI assisted bot to process customer service disputes. The AI bot allegedly contacted Ewa but I didn’t hear from them in a month at which time I warned them that I would file a dispute with my bank and report their business. Downvote this app and report it. They will use a bot to respond to your reviews here.

reviews.title: Watch out
reviews.text:
Update : the developer has commented saying I didn’t contact them. I had been in contact with and they had refused to honour the 14 day money back policy (even though I requested this day 1). Also after I
managed to get the money back through Apple, the developer is still approaching Apple to try to retrieve the money back. 


The app itself is very basic, not just the setup but also the language level. The impression it gives of using books and movies to teach you, is not accurate at all. It all seems like super quick AI with simple things like ‘last night’ being pronounced incorrectly.

Tried to get my money back based on the 14 days no questions asked policy, they gave me before signing up. They said I had to figure it out with my payment provider, they wouldn’t do anything and responses were quick one-liners. Doesn’t seem like a legit company so not sure how they are getting these good reviews.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Hi, I used the Ewa app and enjoyed it, but when I tried to cancel my subscription, I couldn’t find a way to cancel it through my Apple ID or in the app. I deleted my account and the app from my phone. After 3 months, they charged me for a renewal subscription. I wrote to them and explained the issue, but they still insisted on charging. I’ve already deleted the app, but I’m being asked to pay for the unused months as well. It is not fair. Please be aware of the issue, and if you don’t want to use it anymore, FIND THE WAY TO CANCEL YOUR SUBSCRIPTION!!!

reviews.title: No Customer Service
reviews.text:
I signed up yesterday and paid for a three month membership but after doing that couldn’t sign into the app as I didn’t have the temporary password. 
I tried to contact customer service but they’re just a reseller and said they’d contact EWA. So far absolutely no response. I’ve tried to recover the password but get nothing sent to me, so they have £29 of my money and I just have the free version of the app which is starting me as a beginner even though I’m an Intermediate Spanish speaker. 
So far it’s a Rip-off!

reviews.title: Not very good
reviews.text:
I would not recommend this app and I would not buy it again. There are Lots of contradictory translations. Example: click on a single word like “transbordar” in a text about taking the subway and you’ll get transshipping, click on the full paragraph and it translates as transfer.
I was also reading a book selection and found many sentences that if you look at individual words made no sense at all. I also found many words not available to translate and I had to use my translation app. Am I learning new vocabulary? Yes, but certainly not how to use them accurately, especially verbs.
And it’s getting buggier as I go along, not giving me pronunciation or giving me one spoken with an obvious English accent.

reviews.title: Disappointing Experience – Not Worth the Cost
reviews.text: The app did not meet my expectations, and my friends share the same opinion. It’s quite expensive, and once the subscription renews, it’s not possible to get a refund. I recommend being cautious and checking other available options before purchasing this one. I’m disappointed and won’t be using this app again.
